global.title: ABI L2 Land Surface (Skin) Temperature
global.summary: The Land Surface (Skin) Temperature product consists of pixels containing the skin temperatures for each 'clear' or 'probably clear' land surface pixel. This product is generated from a regression algorithm that linearly combines ABI surface emissivity data, brightness temperature, and brightness temperature differences derived from top of atmosphere radiances from ABI bands with wavelengths 11.19 and 12.27 um. Product data is generated both day and night.

global.summary: The Land Surface (Skin) Temperature product consists of pixels containing the skin temperatures for each 'clear' or 'probably clear' land surface pixel. This product is generated from a regression algorithm that linearly combines ABI surface emissivity data, brightness temperature, and brightness temperature differences derived from top of atmosphere radiances from ABI bands with wavelengths 11.19 and 12.27 um. Product data is generated both day and night.
